description_en: Lists backups for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-backups --db-cluster-id am-bp18934i73vb50000 --backup-id 327320000 --start-time 2022-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2022-06-02T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --cross-uid 1950000 --cross-role role-for-xxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html to list cluster IDs in a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域下数仓版集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. It must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30** (default)

- **50**

- **100**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: positive integers greater than 0 and no larger than the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer数据类型最大值的正整数。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the backup set owner.

> Specify this parameter only when backing up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨阿里云主账号，即备份集所属的阿里云主账号。 
>该参数仅在跨阿里云账号备份时填写
parameters.name: cross_uid

parameters.help_en:
The RAM role name of the backup set owner's Alibaba Cloud account.

> Specify this parameter only when backing up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨阿里云账号主账号角色名，即备份集所属阿里云账号下的RAM角色。 
>该参数仅在跨阿里云账号备份时填写
parameters.name: cross_role

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html to list supported regions and zones for AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
